Package mypackage.graph

Interface Graph<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the type of data stored in the vertices
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractGraph, AdjacencyListGraph, AdjacencyMatrixGraph, IncidenceMatrixGraph
public interface Graph<T>
Represents a generic directed graph.

    • equals

      boolean equals(Object o)
      Compares the specified object with this graph for equality. Two graphs are considered equal if they have the same set of vertices and the same set of edges, regardless of their internal representation.
      Overrides:
      equals in class Object
      Parameters:
      o - the object to be compared for equality with this graph
      Returns:
      true if the specified object is equal to this graph

    • hashCode

      int hashCode()
      Returns the hash code value for this graph. The hash code of a graph should be computed based on the sets of its vertices and edges to remain consistent with the equals method.
      Overrides:
      hashCode in class Object
      Returns:
      the hash code value for this graph
